# multiRL

```{r}
multiRL.input <- process_1_input(
  data = read.csv("../DATA/DATA.csv") |> dplyr::filter(Subject == 1),
  colnames = list(
    subid = "Subject", block = "Block", trial = "Trial",
    object = NA_character_, reward = NA_character_, action = "Action"
  ),
  params = list(
    free = list(
      alpha = c(0.3, 0.7),
      beta = 0.5
    ),
    fixed = list(
      gamma = 1,
      delta = 0.1,
      epsilon = 0.1,
      zeta = 1,
      eta = NA_real_
    ),
    constant = list(
      Q1 = NA_real_,
      lapse = 0.01
    )
  ),
  priors = list(
    alpha = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
    beta = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)}
  ),
  funcs = list(
    rate_func = multiRL::func_alpha,
    prob_func = multiRL::func_beta,
    util_func = multiRL::func_gamma,
    bias_func = multiRL::func_delta,
    expl_func = multiRL::func_epsilon
  ),
  settings = list(
    name = "TD",
    mode = "fit",
    policy = "on"
  )
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.behrule <- process_2_behrule(
  behrule = list(
    cue = c("Red", "Yellow", "Green", "Blue"),
    rsp = c("Up", "Down", "Left", "Right")
  )
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.record <- process_3_record(
  input = multiRL.input,
  behrule = multiRL.behrule
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.output <- process_4_output(
  record = multiRL.record
)
```

```{r}
multiRL.metric <- process_5_metric(
  output = multiRL.output
)
```

```{r}
View(multiRL.output@result@value)
View(multiRL.output@result@reward)
View(multiRL.output@result@utility)
View(multiRL.output@result@count)
View(multiRL.output@result@bias)
View(multiRL.output@result@shown)
View(multiRL.output@result@exploration)
View(multiRL.output@result@prob)
```

```{r}
multiRL.model <- run_m(
  data = read.csv("../DATA/DATA.csv") |> dplyr::filter(Subject == 1),
  behrule = list(
    cue = c("Red", "Yellow", "Green", "Blue"),
    rsp = c("Up", "Down", "Left", "Right")
  ),
  params = list(
    free = list(
      alpha = c(0.3, 0.7),
      beta = 0.5
    ),
    fixed = list(
      gamma = 1,
      delta = 0.1,
      epsilon = 0.1,
      zeta = 1,
      eta = NA_real_
    ),
    constant = list(
      Q1 = NA_real_,
      lapse = 0.01
    )
  ),
  whatyousay = c(1, 2, 3)
)
```

## binaryRL

```{r}
binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
  mode = "fit",
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2,
  id = 1,
  n_params = 3,
  n_trials = 360,
  initial_value = 100,
  threshold = 1,
  pi = 0.1,
  epsilon = NA_real_,
  eta = c(0.123, 0.456),
  tau = c(0.789), 
  priors = list(
    eta = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
    tau = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)}
  ),
  policy = "off"
)

summary(binaryRL.res)
```

```{r}
multiRL.model <- run_m(
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2 |> dplyr::filter(Subject == 1),
  behrule = list(
    cue = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    rsp = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
  ),
  colnames = list(
    subid = "Subject", block = "Block", trial = "Trial",
    object = c("L_choice", "R_choice"), 
    reward = c("L_reward", "R_reward"),
    action = "Sub_Choose"
  ),
  params = list(
    free = list(
      alpha = c(0.123, 0.456),
      beta = 0.789
    ),
    fixed = list(
      gamma = 1,
      delta = 0.1,
      epsilon = NA_real_,
      zeta = 1,
      eta = NA_real_
    ),
    constant = list(
      Q1 = NA_real_,
      lapse = 0.01
    )
  ),
  priors = list(
    alpha = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
    beta = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)}
  ),
  settings = list(
    name = "TD",
    mode = "fit",
    policy = "on"
  ),
  anythingelse = c(1, 2, 3)
)

multiRL.summary <- summary(multiRL.model)
```
